platform_roadmap.active_focus: Backend data provider architecture for paper-traded longs

phases.name: Secrets + provider bootstrap
phases.note: Local secrets file is in place. Provider env loading and the first market data client are now wired into benchmark and regime market-tape scripts.

phases.name: Normalized market data layer
phases.note: Daily bars, quote/reference fetches, the growth-scan fundamentals path, and provider-backed event refreshes are now normalized behind shared clients with Polygon/Massive and Finnhub hooks plus Yahoo fallback. Finnhub news now backfills missing direct news coverage instead of double-counting it.

phases.name: Paper long book
phases.note: Keep focus on long-only stock and ETF paper trading before adding options or broker automation.

phases.name: Live console UX
phases.note: Add richer charts and live market views after the backend contracts are reliable.

phases.name: Options sleeve
phases.note: Treat options as a separate speculative sleeve after the long book is behaving well.

phases.name: Broker connection
phases.note: Only consider live execution after forward results, risk limits, and trade ticket flow are trustworthy.
